title: Pet Simulator

content.title: Your Mission
content.body:
Time to build a virtual pet of your own — a dragon, a space slime, a wizard kitten, whatever you want. The player has to take care of it, and the choices they make will change how your pet feels.

Your simulator should:
• Give the pet a name (using input)
• Track at least one stat (hunger, happiness, or energy)
• Have a loop that keeps going until a condition is met
• Offer the player choices for what to do each turn
• React differently depending on the player's choices

content.title: Pet Ideas
content.body:
• A dragon who needs feeding and training
• A space slime who wants to be talked to and played with
• A tiny wizard who needs tea and spell practice
• A puppy, kitten, or imaginary creature of your own invention!

content.title: Useful Patterns

starterCode:
# 🐾 Pet Simulator
# Build a pet the player can take care of!

name = input("What will you name your pet? ")
happiness = 5
print(name, "starts with happiness:", happiness)

while happiness > 0 and happiness < 10:
    action = input("What do you do? ")
    # ↑ What can the player do each turn?
    #   Use if / elif to change `happiness` based on the action.
    print(name, "now has happiness:", happiness)

# Once the loop ends, tell the player how it went.
progressiveHints: Start by choosing one stat to track (e.g. happiness). Set it to a starting number like 5.
Use a while loop that keeps going as long as the stat is between 0 and 10.
Use input() each loop turn to ask the player what they want to do.
Use if/elif/else to check what the player typed and change the stat accordingly.
Print the stat after each turn so the player can see how their pet is doing.
Add a fun message when the player wins or loses at the end of the loop.

milestones.label: Uses input() to ask the player what to do
Uses a while loop to run multiple turns
Uses if/elif to react to the player's choice
Has at least two different actions with elif
Changes a stat variable based on the action

remixIdeas: Add a second stat — maybe hunger AND happiness. Both need to stay balanced!
Add a random event each turn using the random module: import random then random.randint(1,3).
Let the player name an action — "feed fish" or "throw ball" — and parse what they typed.
Add a friendship level that increases when the player makes good choices.
Create a second pet and let the player look after both at the same time.
